svg.aria-label: Same score, very different bill: the four team designs of gpt-6.1-sol finish 27 to 29 of 36 tasks. Over all 36 tasks, Single agent takes 407 hours and reads 17.1 billion tokens; Hierarchical 204 hours and 51.7 billion, 3 times the tokens of Single agent; Decentralized 199 hours and 45.3 billion, half the time of Single agent; Adaptive 258 hours and 27.0 billion
